tool_responses.search_threat_intelligence:
Results for 'Amerithrax investigation Bruce Ivins':
- 2001 anthrax letter attacks targeted US Senate offices and media outlets
- FBI investigation (codename Amerithrax) was one of the largest in US history
- Dr. Bruce E. Ivins, microbiologist at USAMRIID, identified as prime suspect
- Case closed in 2010 after Ivins' death in 2008
tool_responses.draft_briefing: Briefing draft created: 'Amerithrax Case - Investigative Failures Analysis'. Ready for review and editing.
